Operations & Integrator Coordination : 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management

  • Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day-to-day operations and overall team integration.

  • Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.

Marketing & Content Coordination : 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
  • Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.

Content Curation & Social Media Management

  • Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives.
  • Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone.
  • Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.

Strategic Founder & Client Support : 10% Role Allocation

  • Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
  • Turn the Founder\'s ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.
  • Protect the Founder\'s time while supporting the team and aligning priorities.
  • Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow-ups and building relationships.

What You Should Have

Must-haves :

  • At least seven years of experience in Executive Support, Operations, or Integrator roles, ideally supporting C-level or Founder Executives.
  • Experience supporting a Founder or Executive in a Beauty, Wellness, or Lifestyle brand, particularly in fast-paced, multi-business environments.

  • Mastery of English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional tone and neutral accent for both internal coordination and client correspondence.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and manage day-to-day operations.
  • Client-facing experience, with the ability to handle escalations professionally and maintain relationships.
  • Hands-on experience with Zenoti (or similar scheduling / inventory systems) and Shopify for backend coordination and updates.
  • Experience in light copywriting, editing, and scheduling social media content across IG, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google platforms.
  • Proficient in remote office tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack (or Teams).
  • Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp.
  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
  • Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.

Technology Specifications :

  • Windows 11 or MacOS 15 Sequoia
  • Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM
  • Webcam and Headset
  • Designated Quiet Office Space

Nice-to-haves :

  • Basic design knowledge for editing branded visual assets in Canva.

Who You Are

We are hoping you are someone who :

  • Naturally steps in to solve problems, keep things moving, and stays a few steps ahead.
  • Thinks clearly and critically, great at untangling complex challenges, spotting what\'s not working, and helping build smoother systems.
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence, whether giving a quick update to the team or coordinating with external partners, you know how to get the message across with emotional intelligence.
  • Keeps everything (and everyone) on track, juggles timelines, priorities, and moving pieces with calm precision and care for the brand image.

Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.

  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client

Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.

About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Sobre a Simpay

A Simpay é uma Instituição de Pagamento focada em meios de pagamento digitais e PIX, em transição para operações cada vez mais diretas e reguladas. Buscamos alguém mão-na-massa, extremamente organizado e com rigor regulatório para cuidar do fluxo financeiro diário e das obrigações junto ao Banco Central .

Missão da vaga

Garantir envios diários e periódicos ao BCB com acurácia e pontualidade , manter reconciliações financeiras em dia e apoiar a contabilidade no cumprimento de CCS e integrações APIX , assegurando plena aderência às normas aplicáveis a Instituições de Pagamento.

Responsabilidades (o que você fará no dia a dia)

  • Envios diários ao BCB (via APIX / RSFN, quando aplicável) :
  • Posições de saldo em contas (contas de pagamento, contas de liquidação e correlatas).

  • Conferência de retornos, logs e reprocessamentos quando necessário.

  • Calendário regulatório da IP :
  • Manter o calendário de obrigações sempre atualizado (diárias, mensais, trimestrais, anuais).
  • Sinalizar riscos de prazo, antecipar bloqueios e propor planos de ação.
  • Indicadores e reporting :
  • Consolidar e reportar dashboards de acurácia / pontualidade dos envios , posição de saldos, ageing de reconciliações e status de CCS / APIX.

Requisitos

  • Noções de SQL para consultas simples em bases transacionais / BI.
  • Atenção a detalhes, raciocínio contábil e disciplina de processos.
  • Comunicação clara para interface com Contabilidade, Operações, Risco / PLD-FT e parceiros.

    • Diferenciais (bons de ter)

  • Experiência com SPI / PIX , RSFN, participantes responsáveis / liquidantes.
  • Familiaridade com normas recentes do BCB aplicáveis a IPs (ex. : Resoluções BCB 429 / 2024, 496 / 2025, 506 / 2025, 507 / 2025 , entre outras).
  • Python para automação de rotinas / checagens e BigQuery / PostgreSQL .
  • Experiência com conciliação de carteiras (cartão, PIX, split, subcontas) e indicadores operacionais (ex. : devoluções / MED, ageing).

    • Competências comportamentais

  • Rigor (99,9%+ de acurácia), senso de propriedade e urgência .
  • Organização, gestão de prazos e visão de processo ponta-a-ponta.
  • Capacidade de documentar bem e sustentar evidências em auditorias.

description:
Remoto | Oportunidade Global | HeadOffice.ai – San Francisco

Sobre a HeadOffice.ai

Fundada em San Francisco, a HeadOffice.ai é a empresa líder em Agentes de Inteligência Artificial para grandes redes de franquias. Nossa plataforma ajuda empresas a escalarem a comunicação com clientes, colaboradores e parceiros de forma inteligente e eficiente. Já trabalhamos com marcas líderes no Brasil e estamos em expansão global.

A Oportunidade

Estamos em busca de uma Vendedora B2B SaaS para atuar diretamente ao lado da nossa Diretora Comercial na expansão de clientes estratégicos. Esta é uma posição-chave para acelerar nosso crescimento no Brasil, com exposição a grandes redes de franquias, PMEs e empresas enterprise.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir o processo completo de vendas B2B SaaS, da prospecção ao fechamento.
  • Apoiar e trabalhar em conjunto com a Diretora Comercial no relacionamento com grandes contas.
  • Mapear oportunidades de mercado em franquias, PMEs e setores estratégicos.
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais, negociações e contratos.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de CRM e relatórios de vendas para acompanhar pipeline e forecast.
  • Colaborar com os times de marketing, produto e customer success para garantir a satisfação e expansão dos clientes.

Requisitos

  • Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência em vendas B2B SaaS.
  • Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial (IA) e facilidade com uso de tecnologia.
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação, negociação e relacionamento.
  • Perfil proativo, consultivo e orientado a resultados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de CRM e técnicas modernas de vendas.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com franchising ou grandes redes de varejo/serviços.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado (para atuação junto ao time global).
  • Vivência em startups ou scale-ups.

O que oferecemos

  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em uma empresa americana líder em IA.
  • Atuação estratégica ao lado da Diretora Comercial em grandes negociações.
  • Ambiente dinâmico, inovador e de alto impacto no mercado de franquias e PMEs.
  • Pacote competitivo com fixo + comissão agressiva.

Se você tem experiência em vendas SaaS, gosta de tecnologia e quer crescer em uma empresa global de IA, venha fazer parte da HeadOffice.ai!

description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!

Buscamos

Analista de Desenvolvimento Pleno - Engenheiro de Dados

Resumo

Buscamos uma pessoa com um conhecimento em engenharia e análise de dados, principalmente voltada para soluções na Azure. Trabalhará com plataformas e aplicações disponíveis na Kantar e a principal responsabilidade é planejar e desenvolver soluções desde a arquitetura até a entrega (desde a arquitetura, passando pela ETL e finalizando na visualização dos dados no Power Bi), passando por todas as etapas do desenvolvimento de software.

O que você irá fazer

  • Levantamento e Análise de Requisitos: Entender junto ao cliente quais as necessidades de negócio, propor soluções e documentar essas necessidades através de especificações funcionais;
  • Executar tarefas em todas as fases do ciclo de desenvolvimento (Análise, Design de Arquitetura, Codificação e Deploy);
  • Participar da definição de processos e ferramentas;
  • Participar na elaboração e na manutenção da documentação técnica dos sistemas desenvolvidos;
  • Sustentação das aplicações em produção, visando garantir a estabilidade e disponibilidade destes sistemas.

O que buscamos?

Qualificações fundamentais

  • Sólida experiência como analista ou engenheiro de dados;
  • Formação: Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistema da Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio dos conceitos de programação (estruturas de dados, lógica de programação, algoritmos, orientação a objetos, etc);
  • Coleta e preparação dos dados (mapeamento de fontes, ETL e limpeza de dados usando Azure Databricks);
  • Análise de dados (exploração, identificação de padrões, criação de dashboards no Power BI);
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de bancos de dados relacional e multidimensional;
  • Conhecimento em consultas a Data Warehouse Hive (HiveSQL);
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento na linguagem PySpark / Python;
  • Experiencia com PowerBI;
  • Conhecimento em Azure Devops (principalmente Repos e CI / CD);
  • Conceitos de metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento (SCRUM e / ou KANBAN).

Qualificações desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento e orquestração de pipelines de dados utilizando ADF (Azure Data Factory);
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados não relacional;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura e aplicações Azure.

Idioma: Inglês intermediário é imprescindível.

O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade / Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
  • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
  • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Customer Experience
  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles
  • Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program / Project management
  • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
  • Experience with Networking / Security Products
  • Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais : Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam : Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho :

  • Fornecer suporte técnico direto aos clientes focados na solução de Comércio Exterior (OSGT - OneSource Global Trade);
  • Utilizar a linguagem PL / SQL como base principal para todas as análises e investigações, criação de scripts para pequenas rotinas de manutenção;
  • Realizar investigações técnicas (debug) em PL / SQL com banco de dados ORACLE;
  • Atuar diretamente no monitoramento e troubleshooting das Integrações entre a OSGT;
  • Prestar atendimento ao cliente via telefone e / ou Teams, solucionando dúvidas e eventuais problemas da versão de forma eficaz;
  • Trabalhar com interação direta com todos os Módulos da OSGT (Importação, Exportação, Regimes Especiais, Drawback, etc);
  • Atuar em conjunto com diferentes departamentos para garantir a integração e funcionamento adequado dos sistemas;
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica detalhada sobre os processos e integrações realizadas
  • Analisar e documentar toda da análise técnica e funcional realizada para compartilhamento aos times de desenvolvimento.

O que você precisa ter :

  • Experiência como analista de suporte ao sistema OSGT (ONESOURCE Global Trade), nos módulos de Import, Export, Cambio Import e Cambio Export;
  • Experiência em PL / SQL para suporte técnico (debug de objetos base).

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.

The Role

As Vendry’s Business Development Manager, you’ll be the frontline force helping brands kick off their search for the right agency partner, helping to craft their marketing strategies in the process. You’ll be responsible for leading our sales efforts with inbound RFP clients—those who have already expressed interest in starting an agency search through Vendry. This is not a traditional outbound-heavy role. Instead, it’s about deeply understanding each client’s needs, pitching our process, running intro calls, managing follow-ups, and ensuring a seamless transition into the matchmaking phase.

You’ll serve as both consultant and salesperson, ensuring that every interested brand sees the value in Vendry’s approach—and ultimately trusts us to guide them through their agency selection journey.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle for inbound agency search clients—from initial inquiry through signed engagement with our partners.
  • Conduct consultative sales calls to understand each client’s marketing needs and present Vendry’s search process.
  • Build and deliver compelling pitch materials and follow-ups that reflect Vendry’s value proposition.
  • Collaborate closely with the Agency Operations team to ensure smooth handoff and client experience.
  • Maintain detailed records in our CRM to track pipeline activity and conversion metrics.
  • Help evolve our sales materials and process based on feedback and performance.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in a sales or client-facing role, ideally in marketing, advertising, or agency services.
  • Proven ability to run structured sales calls and close consultative deals.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Organized, self-motivated, and comfortable managing multiple prospects at once.
  • Experience working in a remote environment and using CRM tools like HubSpot or Salesforce.
  • Based in Canada and able to work full-time remotely.

Why Join Vendry

Joining Vendry means joining a team at the forefront of transforming how brands find their marketing partners. You’ll work directly with marketers at companies big and small, helping them discover agencies that can take their brand to the next level. We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values creativity, strategic thinking, and initiative.

If you’re a self-starter with a passion for marketing and building relationships, we’d love to hear from you.

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.

Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite.
  • Month-End Workbooks: Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Reporting: Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).
  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.

Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits / credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.
  • US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client

Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.

About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Core Values

title: Executivo De Vendas
description:
Sobre a Verzo

A Verzo foi fundada em 2015 com o objetivo de auxiliar os hospitais e prestadores de serviço de saúde a aprimorarem seus resultados financeiros. Iniciamos movidos pelo propósito de ajudar a saúde do Brasil e animados com os desafios que o setor propicia.

Começamos como Aliança Hospitalar, prestando serviços de consultoria para hospitais. Logo nos apaixonamos por tecnologia e criamos o sistema VERZO. Com um time qualificado, o VERZO cresceu de forma exponencial e hoje atuamos com hospitais de todos os portes e perfis em todos os cantos do Brasil. Nos tornamos nativos de tecnologia e adotamos o nome VERZO para nossa companhia.

Durante a pandemia, percebemos o impacto causado não só nas instituições mas também nas pessoas. Decidimos lançar novas soluções de simples adesão, rápida implantação e que facilitassem a vida dos profissionais da área da saúde.

Hoje atendemos os hospitais e redes mais exigentes em termos de tecnologia e resultados. Estamos sempre inovando e criando novas soluções em parcerias com nossos clientes.

Viemos para ficar, valorizamos relações duradouras e a satisfação de nossos clientes é nosso principal objetivo.

O que fazemos

Por meio de ciência de dados proprietária, nossas ferramentas trazem um ROI (retorno do investimento) claro e atrativo, além de apoiarmos as equipes na gestão financeira, cadastro, ciclo de receita, suprimentos e fiscal no atingimento de seus objetivos. Já foram identificados mais de R$ 2 bilhões em oportunidades de aumento de lucro para +350 clientes no país.

Formamos parcerias com essas equipes que, com o uso de nossas ferramentas, entregam mais resultados para seus gestores como redução de glosas / bloqueios, aumento da rentabilidade de medicamentos e materiais médicos, tanto via redução de custos quanto aumento de receita e revisão de mix, e automatização de processos de controle da cadeia de fornecedores e fiscais. Além disso, otimizamos processos internos via tecnologia para liberar tempo da equipe para dedicar atenção e esforços ao que realmente gera valor.

Tudo que desenvolvemos foi com base no feedback das dores destas equipes em diversos hospitais Brasil afora. Conhecemos profundamente as necessidades do setor e sabemos como ajudar.

Prêmios e reconhecimentos

A Verzo é celebrada por sua excelência em inovação e qualidade de serviço. Fomos honrados com diversos reconhecimentos ao longo de nossa história como os destaques de “Tendência para a Saúde em 2024” pela Revista Medicina S / A em 2024, “Top Latin America HealthTech” pela HeathCare Tech Outlook em 2022, e selecionados pela Endeavor como uma das empresas de alto impacto no Brasil por meio do programa Scale Up Endeavor no mesmo ano.

Descrição da vaga e responsabilidades

Estamos em busca de um Executivo de Vendas para integrar nossa equipe. As principais responsabilidades da posição incluem:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes.
  • Gerenciar funil de vendas de ponta a ponta: prospecção, qualificação, apresentações, propostas e fechamento.
  • Conduzir reuniões de demonstração do produto.
  • Negociar aspectos comerciais e garantir a melhor experiência do cliente durante o processo comercial.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Marketing e Customer Success para alinhar estratégias e melhorar a jornada do cliente.
  • Alimentar e organizar o CRM, garantindo previsibilidade de pipeline.
  • Atingir e superar metas de vendas.

Local de trabalho

O trabalho será remoto, permitindo desempenho das funções de onde desejar. Por vezes, haverá necessidade de viagens para eventos e encontros presenciais com clientes.

Regime de contratação:

Contrato PJ.

Requisitos mínimos

Ao liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento de negócios, você desempenha um papel crucial no crescimento da Verzo e na melhoria contínua da saúde no Brasil. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para o sucesso dos hospitais parceiros, proporcionando resultados tangíveis e impactando positivamente a qualidade dos serviços de saúde oferecidos.

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em saúde, tecnologia e SaaS.
  • Histórico consistente de atingimento ou superação de metas.
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, consultiva e orientada a soluções.
  • Possuir conhecimento do setor de saúde e do segmento hospitalar.
  • Capacidade de lidar com diferentes perfis de clientes e influenciadores de decisão (C-level, gestores e técnicos).
  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas e ferramentas de CRM.
  • Disponibilidade para participação em eventos e encontros presenciais que envolvam viagens.
  • Imersão no entendimento dos produtos da Verzo e nas metodologias de vendas, com foco em SPICED, SPIN e CHALLENGER SALE.

O que valorizamos

  • Experiência prévia no setor de saúde.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo e orientado a resultados.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico e de rápido crescimento.
  • Interesse genuíno em gerar impacto positivo no setor de saúde, via inovação, inteligência de dados e tecnologia.
  • Possuir contatos com profissionais do setor e / ou carteira de clientes ativa.

Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e explorar como podemos construir uma jornada de sucesso juntos.

Se você está em busca de uma oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa que valoriza a inovação e a excelência na saúde, a Verzo é o lugar ideal para você. Venha fazer parte do nosso time e contribuir com a vida!

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
  • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
  • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Customer Experience
  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles
  • Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program / Project management
  • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
  • Experience with Networking / Security Products
  • Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues

    • Additional Information

    The Team

    The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.

    Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

    As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.

    Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.

    Our Commitment

    We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

    We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

title: Venue Operations Manager – 8 Host Cities (Brazil)
description:
Venue Operations Manager – 8 Host Cities (Brazil)

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil


Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.


THE POSITION

Reporting to Senior Venue Operations Manager, and working alongside the FIFA Tournament & Venue Operations team in Zurich, the Venue Operations Manager is responsible for ensuring that the stadium is delivered in full compliance with FIFA Hosting Requirements and for leading the operational delivery of all FWWC2027 matches and non-matchday activities at the venue.
The tournament will be staged across 8 stadiums in Brazil, and we’re recruiting one Venue Operations Manager for each host city:

  • Belo Horizonte - Estádio Mineirão
  • Brasília - Estádio Nacional
  • Fortaleza - Arena Castelão
  • Porto Alegre - Estádio Beira-Rio
  • Recife - Arena de Pernambuco
  • Rio de Janeiro - Estádio do Maracanã
  • Salvador - Arena Fonte Nova
  • São Paulo - Arena Itaquera

Please apply only if you currently live in one of these cities or can relocate there independently.

The position requires the effective and efficient management of all venue operations, ensuring seamless coordination with FIFA’s functional areas as well as internal and external stakeholders. Key areas of focus include transparency, communication, issue escalation, problem-solving, innovation, and the use of reporting tools to guarantee operational excellence.

The Venue Operations Manager will act as a coordinator, facilitator, and decision-maker at the stadium. Together with the FIFA27 Senior Venue Manager, the FIFA FWWC Lead Venue Management team, and the FIFA27 Head of Operations, this role holds ultimate responsibility for venue event planning, operational readiness, and on-site implementation, in close collaboration with all stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible for the operational delivery of each match day and non-match day at the venue.
  • Will liaise with all functional areas including Competitions, Broadcast, Media, Dressing & Signage, Fan Operations, Pitch Management, Partnerships Rights Delivery, Technical Services & Overlay, Stadium Entertainment, Ticketing, Hospitality, Technology, FTI (Football Technology Innovation), Catering as well as other functional areas such as Services (Logistics, Transport, Guest Management) and Safety, Security, Accreditation & Access and Workforce and Volunteer Management, to ensure the smooth, efficient and effective operation at the venue for all constituent groups.
  • Establish constructive communication channels between FIFA, FIFA27, venue and local authorities and stakeholders.
  • Co-ordinate with all stakeholders (i.e. Host City authorities, venue operators, public transport, police & emergency services) at a venue level through regular coordinated meetings and/or workshops, to ensure the smooth running of events at the venue.
  • To integrate all relevant operational plans into effective venue plans.
  • To assess and validate FIFA’s event requirements to the reality of the venue.
  • Integration of all relevant functional area operational plans into the stadium environment.
  • Risk identification and mitigation across the venue.
  • Supervise and support stadium renovation and construction projects, assuring FIFA requirements are met.
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Contribution to workshops, seminars and meetings with FIFA, FIFA27, Host Country and site authorities.
  • Coordination of policies, requirements and planning with FIFA, FIFA27, Host Country and site authorities.
  • Co-ordination, planning and delivery of official test events.
  • Plan, manage and implement a good quality and cost-efficient on-site support, service and operations for all relevant FIFA departments as well as other stakeholders (i.e. sponsors, service providers, etc.).
  • Organize and lead Stadium Inspection Tours.
  • Full support to functional areas on site visits, activities and post inspection BIM360 follow up.
  • Manage and review the Stadium budget including regular reporting.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 8 years of management experience in multi-purpose arenas, professional sports clubs, or large-scale international sporting events.
  • Proven ability to lead large, multidisciplinary teams with strong stakeholder management skills across international and multicultural environments.
  • Excellent communication and crisis management skills, with the ability to remain calm under pressure and provide decisive leadership.
  • Strong knowledge of event planning, operations, and project management processes.
  • Familiarity with the host stadium and its operational environment will be considered an asset.
  • Demonstrated experience in the development and integration of operational plans across multiple functional areas (e.g., security, spectator services, media, broadcast, hospitality).
  • Experience in budgeting, financial oversight, and resource management for large-scale events.
  • Strong understanding of health & safety, risk management, and security regulations in stadium operations.
  • Proven track record in managing complex international projects involving multiple stakeholders and authorities.

Education

  • University degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education).
  • Bilingual - Brazilian Portuguese and English
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong team player, able to work collaboratively while meeting tight deadlines.
  • Solution-oriented mindset with persistence, resilience, and a positive attitude under pressure.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage high workloads efficiently during peak operational periods.
  • Sound judgment, critical problem-solving ability, and capacity to make key decisions under pressure.
  • Effective leadership skills, including motivational leadership, negotiation, and relationship management.
  • High levels of energy, adaptability, and entrepreneurial spirit.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Experience or knowledge of the local culture and market will be considered an advantage.
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast-changing environment.
  • Adaptable and culturally sensitive, with proven experience working across international and cross-cultural contexts.


Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Based in one of the listed cities (Belo Horizonte, Brasília, Fortaleza, Porto Alegre, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador & São Paulo) or able to relocate there independently

Team members are expected to monitor and triage production incidents, providing feedback and support throughout the incident lifecycle. Personnel work directly with architecture, infrastructure, application and operational support teams to provide support of day to day maintenance activities such as certificate renewals, network configuration changes, patching, software deployments, etc.

  • Assists in other areas of the department and company as necessary.

  • Use combination of various tools to correlate multiple faults and/or system presented data into defined events.
  • May provide leadership, coaching, or mentoring to junior level team members.

Qualifications

  • 4-6 years of technical experience in a similar environment reviewing, analyzing, and evaluating the operation of IT systems.
  • Bachelor's degree in CIS, MIS, ideal or must have related field or work experience.
  • Splunk certifications preferred.
  • VMware certifications preferred.
  • Network+ or A+ certification preferred.
  • Basic coding or scripting knowledge such as PowerShell, Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS preferred.
  • Understanding of TCP/IP and the OSI model.
  • Intermediate to advanced understanding of Unix/Linux OS.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Can handle complex issues and problems with little to no supervisor involvement.
  • Analytical thinking skills and detail oriented.

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
  • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
  • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Customer Experience
  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles
  • Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program / Project management
  • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
  • Experience with Networking / Security Products
  • Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues

    • Additional Information

    The Team

    The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.

    Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

    As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.

    Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.

    Our Commitment

    We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager – Operational Excellence

100% Remote | Full-Time | Work with a Global Team

We’re looking for a driven Project Operations Manager to bring order, discipline, and results to our Sales and Marketing teams — and beyond.

Join our award-winning team! Ranked #170 on the Inc. 5000 list and recognized as a Clutch Award-winning agency. Trivium Group is a full-service Amazon agency helping brands scale profitably on Amazon, but this role goes further: you’ll be part of the Operations team driving structure and performance across our portfolio of businesses.

If you can turn chaos into clear processes, own the tools that show us exactly how we’re performing, and keep fast-moving teams accountable, you’re who we’re looking for.

Your Mission

Turn chaos into clarity and performance. Start with Sales and Marketing — building processes, clean data, and real accountability — then expand the same discipline across our portfolio of businesses. Your job is to make sure we always know exactly how we’re performing, fix what’s broken fast, and push what works even further.

Responsibilities

Sales

  • Oversee and improve Sales team performance, tackling underperformance head-on
  • Own HubSpot at an admin level (pipelines, properties, automations, sequences, dashboards) — with executive-grade reporting that makes KPIs and performance crystal clear
  • Implement corrective action plans when off track, and identify growth opportunities when ahead
  • Analyse dips using our in-house AI tools and lead improvement projects to completion
  • Create a Sales Playbook for every role to ensure consistency and efficiency

Marketing

  • Bring strong management and process discipline to ensure on-time, high-quality delivery
  • Own HubSpot at an admin level as well, as mentioned for Sales.
  • Implement and monitor all processes in ClickUp, ensuring documentation and compliance
  • Manage supplier relationships — clear scope, timely delivery, quality results
  • Align organic marketing with paid media buying for maximum impact
  • Own budget management, tracking ROI on every campaign
  • Learn our brands (including Mina’s personal brand and Trivium) to ensure aligned and effective strategies

Requirements

  • Fluent English (written & spoken) with strong communication skills
  • Hands-on systems implementer: HubSpot admin skills (workflows, custom objects/properties, reports), ClickUp workflow design, advanced Google Sheets/Excel (lookups, pivots, queries). Comfortable unblocking with APIs/zaps when needed.
  • Exceptional process design, implementation, and improvement skills. You love turning chaos into beautiful systems that you design, implement, monitor and constantly improve. You are obsessed with reaching excellence through incremental continuous improvement.
  • Strong data analysis ability — spot trends and act fast.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Thrives in extremely high-pace environments: Highly organized, able to switch contexts seamlessly and deal with ambiguity, resilient under pressure, and motivated by continuous challenges — all while maintaining balance within a 40-hour workweek (no overtime expected).

Compensation & Benefits

  • Monthly Salary $2k - $3k USD
  • 36 PTO days per year
  • 100% Remote Work – work from anywhere
  • Professional Development & Growth Opportunities
  • Core Hours: 9:00 AM – 2:00 PM EST (3 hours/day flexible)

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all qualified candidates.

description:
Overview


O Hospital Maternidade Maria Amélia Buarque de Hollanda integra a Rede de Atenção materno-infantil e ginecológica no Município do Rio de Janeiro. Suas ações têm por objetivo garantir a integralidade na linha de cuidado, visando a ampliação e qualificação do acesso humanizado das gestantes à assistência hospitalar. Seus processos e fluxos assistenciais estão ancorados no acolhimento com classificação de risco e em Diretrizes Clínicas baseadas em evidências que viabilizam a resolutividade e a qualidade na atenção prestada. Inaugurada em 2012, a Maternidade oferta atividades assistenciais 24 horas por dia, todos os dias, incluindo sábados, domingos e feriados. O Serviço possui papel estratégico na atenção perinatal em articulação com os demais serviços da Rede de Atenção à Saúde, articulada com a rede de atenção primária à saúde da AP 1.0 e regiões circunvizinhas.


Responsabilidades e atribuições



  • Organizar a operacionalização do serviço de Enfermagem e garantir o bom andamento dos serviços; realizar orientações aos pacientes; manter controle de salas, equipamentos e leitos disponíveis; orientar o trabalho da equipe de técnicos;

  • Atender às normativas do Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN);

  • Garantir o cumprimento das rotinas, normas e protocolos institucionais e de SMS;

  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem ao usuário, desde a sua admissão, e acompanhar o atendimento técnico;

  • Atuar como facilitador de todos os processos que envolvem o atendimento de enfermagem;

  • Promover, juntamente ao gestor, ambiente que proporcione melhorias contínuas no processo assistencial;

  • Manter a comunicação com o corpo clínico, referente a mudanças no fluxo da Assistência de Enfermagem (quando interferir em processo médico);

  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem segura, humanizada e individualizada aos pacientes;

  • Garantir o cumprimento de normas e recomendações estabelecidas junto aos serviços de saúde, colaborando para o controle de infecção;

  • Ministrar treinamentos quando necessário promovendo atualização contínua à equipe de enfermagem;

  • Auxiliar o gestor no controle de certificação profissional da equipe de enfermagem junto ao conselho de classe, bem como executar o processo de comunicação junto aos órgãos competentes;

  • Conduzir a gestão das notificações de não conformidades de avaliação de eficácia, referentes à Assistência de Enfermagem;

  • Gerir o controle de entrada e saída de materiais estocados no setor, mantendo o estoque mínimo necessário para o desenvolvimento da Assistência de Enfermagem;

  • Preencher e supervisionar o preenchimento dos registros específicos da Assistência de Enfermagem;

  • Assegurar a correta utilização dos equipamentos e acessórios disponíveis para o processo assistencial;

  • Prestar assistência a pacientes graves, desde a admissão, e acompanhá-los em caso de remoção a outro serviço;

  • Organizar o processo de armazenamento de receituários controlados;

  • Organizar e controlar o processo de esterilização de materiais;

  • Supervisionar ou acompanhar a realização de procedimentos assistenciais, enfocando segurança e diminuição de riscos de infecção;

  • Acompanhar a eficácia da escala de serviços da equipe de enfermagem;

  • Cumprir e fazer cumprir normas e recomendações de Biossegurança, mantendo o ambiente seguro para o paciente e a equipe multiprofissional;

  • Participar das ações de parceria entre a unidade de saúde e as instituições de ensino, considerando a indissociabilidade da relação entre ensino e serviço, apoiando o desenvolvimento de campos de estágio, pesquisa e/ou residência no seu setor de trabalho;

  • Apoiar e propiciar condições para aquisição de conhecimentos no campo profissional de estagiários e/ou residentes nas atividades assistenciais sob sua responsabilidade, quando solicitado e conforme avaliação junto ao gestor imediato;

  • Observar o cumprimento dos aspectos éticos envolvidos na assistência ao usuário, quando os espaços de atendimento e a realização de procedimentos envolvam a participação de estagiários, pesquisadores e/ou residentes;

  • Participar das oportunidades de formação e desenvolvimento ofertadas como contrapartida pelas instituições de ensino.

  • Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;

  • Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD.

  • Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.


Requisitos e qualificações



  • Possuir Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem.

  • Possuir Pós-graduação - especialização completa em Obstetrícia.

  • Possuir Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.

  • Possuir experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Enfermeiro em Maternidade.

  • Possuir fácil acesso ao Centro do Rio.

  • Possuir disponibilidade total para atuar em formato de plantão 12x60 (plantão a ser definido).

Overview

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós :

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam : Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional no segmento de petróleo e gás.

Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) ServiceNow SME (Subject Matter Expert) com foco em AppEngine, altamente experiente e com perfil generalista. Este(a) profissional será responsável pelo desenho, desenvolvimento e governança de aplicações customizadas e fluxos de trabalho dentro da plataforma ServiceNow. A posição exige uma combinação de conhecimento técnico avançado, pensamento estratégico e capacidade de colaborar com diversas áreas da organização.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações customizadas utilizando AppEngine Studio, Flow Designer e IntegrationHub;
  • Projetar soluções escaláveis, seguras e sustentáveis, alinhadas às melhores práticas da plataforma e aos padrões internos;
  • Atuar como mentor técnico para desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, conduzindo revisões de código e orientações técnicas;
  • Colaborar com stakeholders para traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções eficientes na plataforma;
  • Garantir governança, reutilização de componentes e conformidade com a arquitetura interna;
  • Integrar o ServiceNow com sistemas externos via REST / SOAP APIs.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Proficiência avançada em JavaScript, Glide API e demais componentes de script do ServiceNow;
  • Forte experiência com AppEngine, Flow Designer, Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs, UI Policies e filtros;
  • Conhecimento de módulos como HRSD, S2P e outros plugins ServiceNow;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de DevOps, Automated Test Framework (ATF) e uso do GitHub;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, com forte capacidade de análise e resolução de problemas.

Certificações Plenas (desejáveis)

  • Certified Application Developer (CAD)

Your mission is to craft high-quality, scalable user interfaces that power our core research products delivering intuitive experiences for our customers while also enabling internal teams to move faster with confidence.

Monitor and optimize application performance, resolving bottlenecks proactively.

Advocate for and document best practices in frontend development.

Own and architect systems or product areas end-to-end, designing solutions that scale across multiple teams and business domains.

Build strong cross-functional relationships to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment.

Write clean, modular, and maintainable code that stands the test of time.

Continuously improve and refactor existing codebases for reliability and efficiency.

Take responsibility for production systems through on-call rotations, ensuring stability and fast incident resolution.

Mentor and sponsor engineers at all levels, building future technical leaders and spreading best practices throughout the company.

Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time driving cross-team technical initiatives and architectural decisions.

Highly proficient in Next.js 14+ (App Router), including expertise in data caching strategies and performance optimization.

Demonstrates proficiency in various UI rendering architectures (SSR, CSR, SSG, ISR) and the ability to determine their appropriate application.

A proven expertise in designing and implementing robust UI solutions using TypeScript, with a strong focus on applying comprehensive typing throughout the stack to deliver maintainable and highly reliable user experiences.

Proficiency in breaking down product documents and abstracts into well-defined feature epics and user stories, driving features from concept to reality promptly.

Experience with CSS and Tailwind, and in working with Figma and internal design systems.

Track record of building reliable, performant systems and establishing testing and quality practices adopted across teams.

Demonstrates strong communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Proven ability to define and drive technical standards across multiple teams or product lines, aligning stakeholders and ensuring adoption.

Experience balancing trade-offs between technical debt, speed, and long-term scalability in a way that advances organizational goals.

You will be a product-oriented and platform UI engineer, taking full ownership of the end-to-user experience. Write clean, modular, and maintainable code that stands the test of time.

Continuously improve and refactor existing codebases for reliability and efficiency.

Take responsibility for production systems through on-call rotations, ensuring stability and fast incident resolution.

Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.

Qualifications

7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time driving cross-team technical initiatives and architectural decisions.

Highly proficient in Next.Js 14+ (App Router), including expertise in data caching strategies and performance optimization.
